scripts.data: python3 -I pipeline/catalogue.py && python3 -I pipeline/fetch_city.py && python3 -I pipeline/fetch_extra.py && python3 -I pipeline/build.py
scripts.data:refresh: python3 -I pipeline/catalogue.py && python3 -I pipeline/fetch_city.py --refresh && python3 -I pipeline/fetch_extra.py --refresh && python3 -I pipeline/build.py
scripts.test:unit: node --experimental-strip-types --test unit/access-config.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s pipeline/tests
